comparison.objective: Reconnect a car battery positive cable; unlike tuning a shock absorber and validating carriage deceleration.
comparison.physical_skill: May involve aligning a terminal clamp and tightening a fastener, overlapping generically with tool use and force-limited tightening; candidate additionally requires collar adjustment, counterholding, and iterative response-based commissioning. The only body text is “Adds tasks/car-battery-clamp.” and specs are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies a physically reattached positive cable, but no clamp seating, torque, electrical, safety, or damage rubric is available. Candidate requires unlocking before adjustment, relocking, two safe cycles, and bounded drift.
comparison.reason: Although both may test fastening and tool alignment, battery-terminal reconnection tests clamp seating and attachment, not adjustment of a retained control setting based on observed dynamics.
